title: [v0.92.1][TAIL-06.01][runtime] Make dynamic-agent removal crash-consistent
goal: Make dynamic-agent removal recoverable and deterministic across every persistence boundary.
summary: Implement one issue-local crash-consistency protocol and restart reconciliation for dynamic-agent removal.
required_outcome: Removal is atomic from the Runtime lifecycle perspective and idempotently recoverable after interruption.
repo_inputs: Issue757; parent522; source findings A520-ARCH-001 and C520-CODE-001; scoped Runtime persistence code and tests.
target_files_surfaces: adl-runtime-kernel/src/control.rs; adl-runtime-kernel/src/agent_partial_checkpoint.rs; coupled Runtime tests and issue757 evidence.
non_goals: No broad persistence rewrite or unrelated agent/provider behavior.
validation_plan: Focused deterministic local CPU tests for all persistence boundaries plus Runtime owner lane and independent exact-head review.
dependencies: #522 and #520 provide scope authority; continuity proof regeneration follows this repair.
plan_summary: Model removal with a durable authoritative intent/state; make roster and tombstone writes recoverable; reconcile partial states on startup; update in-memory projections only after durable convergence; prove each crash boundary.
